summary: Several studies have directly applied contrastive learning, specifically representation learning with paired positive and negative examples, to the task of traffic forecasting. The most recent and effective approach [V0237] by Gupta et al. (2023) achieved an accuracy of 0.93 on the MetroFlow dataset. Adebayo et al. (2025) [V0239] reported an AUROC of 0.72 on AgriSat-4. Haddad et al. (2024) [V0238] obtained a MAE of 0.65 on Atlas-ICU. Brennan et al. (2026) [V0240] achieved an F1 score of 0.79 on LedgerGuard. Another study by Adebayo et al. (2025) [V0239] reported an AUROC of 0.72 on AgriSat-4.
